extraction_notes.KNOWN_WEAKNESS_IN_THIS_EXTRACTION_READ_B: A large share of the EXTRACTED_CONFIRMED hints in this file rest on AGENT_CHANNEL.md. The channel is ALSO orchestrator-authored. For an audit whose target is the orchestrator's narrative layer, a durable-state claim matching the channel is NOT two independent signals - it is the same author agreeing with himself across two files, which is exactly the failure mode under investigation. Grades resting on a channel match should therefore be read as 'internally consistent', not 'verified'. The grades that rest on a NON-orchestrator artifact - the ledger JSON, graph.json, GRAPH_REPORT.md, git log subjects, file existence and line counts, cell spec.json and verdict.json, source files - are the ones carrying real evidential weight. Grades in the first class: MS-03, MS-04, MS-05, MS-06, MS-08, DY-03, DY-06, PG-03, PE-01, PE-03, PF-03, PY-01(partly), JD-05, JN-08.
